articles.summary: Wilmington, N.C. Franchise Owner Leads One of the Most Unusual Window Film Installations Helping Preserve a Decommissioned Coast Guard Tower Turned Eco-Tourism Landmark Tint World® Automotive Styling Centers™ recently completed one of the more unconventional installations in the brand's history: applying protective window film to Frying Pan Shoals Tower , a decommissioned U.S. Coast Guard light station located 34 miles off the North Carolina coast and accessible only by helicopter or boat. The project marks a unique collaboration between Tint World® and XPEL (Nasdaq: XPEL), a global leader in protective films and coatings. Tint World® Automotive Styling Centers™ and XPEL recently applied protective window film to the Frying Pan Shoals Tower, a decommissioned U.S. Coast Guard light station located 34 miles off the North Carolina coast, now operating as a nonprofit eco-tourism destination.
